lead_headline: Restaurant tracker flags two new leads Monday — Sabores De La Preferida (Park Hill) and Peach & Jack's Bar (Capitol Hill) — as system resumes after weekend silence

restaurant.blurb: 2 new leads Monday — Sabores De La Preferida (Park Hill gas station counter) and Peach & Jack's Bar & Grill (Capitol Hill, former Pearl lesbian bar space). System resumes post-weekend.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications Monday as filing freeze persists into fourth consecutive business day. No status changes, no removals — administrative machinery entirely idle. 3 applications this week remain steady at prior week's baseline, confirming sustained post-backlog plateau as liquor board maintains low-volume operational rhythm with no signals of reacceleration.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Monday pushes BusinessDen citation blackout to 20 consecutive days — full three weeks without single media pickup. All-time total frozen at 1,167 mentions from 111 sources since August 5. Past 30 days: 23 mentions (down from 29 Sunday as more July data ages out). Twenty-day void now exceeds all prior gaps in tracking history — monitoring feeds appear severed or industry citation infrastructure fundamentally broken with zero recovery trajectory.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +9 yesterday (11 new, 2 canceled) lifts MTD to +31 (+1.3/day), 90-day net at +93. Past 7 days: +34 net (47 new, 13 canceled) vs. prior week's +25 — nine-subscriber gain reflects steadier acquisition momentum as Sunday's strong close (+6 net) extends weekend strength into Monday. Two-week pattern shows consistent improvement: Week 1 posted +25 baseline, Week 2 climbs to +34 as new subscriber intake rises 18% (47 vs. 40) while churn holds steady. August maintains recovery trajectory as YTD baseline (+248, +1.1/day) confirms long-term stability beneath accelerating weekly performance.
